messages.author: b3f6c132c4206fae
messages.subject: Histogram can not plot this?
parts:
Hi everyone,

Can someone test this and let me know if this works?

x1 <- rchisq(10000, df = 2) * 10^9
qplot(x = x1, data = data.frame(x1=x1), geom = "histogram")


I got an error message saying:
Error: position_stack requires non-overlapping x intervals


I have no clue why this is happening, as the regular hist() works fine
on x1. Thanks.

Stanley

Works fine for me!

Hadley

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Histogram can not plot this?
parts:
Weird, I must have just got lucky. Running it a few more times
revealed the problem, which I've fixed in the next version. Basically
it's a floating point problem - you can't check for overlap with
equality, and the test I was using failed when the bins were very
large (as in this case).

Hadley
